newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates unchanged to slightly up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates unchanged to slightly up.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted steady to higher on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Wednedsay.
No barges traded versus none Tuesday.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi, next week, bid 110 percent of tariff - no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mississippi (St.Paul-Savage), next week, bid 137-1/2 percent - up 2-1/2 percentage points.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of August, bid 117-1/2 percent - unchanged, offered 125 - unchanged.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), one each week of August, bid 125 percent, offered 132-1/2 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi, two each week of September 21 and 28, bid 207-1/2 percent - up 2-1/2 percent, offered 220 - no comparison on either value.
- Six barges, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), two each weeks of Nov 2 to 16, bid 210 percent - unchanged, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of November, bid 175 percent, offered 185 percent - both values unchanged.
